lines.text: While Ezra wept before the house of God, Shecaniah proposed a covenant to send away the foreign wives and their children.
Ezra made the leading priests, Levites, and all Israel take an oath, then mourned in the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib.
Everyone who failed to gather in Jerusalem within seven days would lose his property, and the men of Judah and Benjamin came.
The assembly proposed that leaders represent everyone, with each town's men coming at appointed times with the elders and singers of their town.
Ezra selected family heads, and the investigation began on the first day of the tenth month.
